text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: The vertical axis shows self-reported life satisfaction in the Cantril Ladder (0-10 point scale with higher values
representing higher life satisfaction). The horizontal axis shows the share of children who die before age five.

tspan.tspan: Wellbeing Research Centre (2026); United Nations Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (2025)
